scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run dev:frontend"
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run db:validate && pnpm run check:backend && pnpm --filter @cekrir/frontend check
scripts.check:backend: uv run --project apps/backend ruff check apps/backend && uv run --project apps/backend ruff format --check apps/backend
scripts.test:backend: pnpm run db:test:deploy && uv run --project apps/backend pytest apps/backend/tests
scripts.format: uv run --project apps/backend ruff format apps/backend && oxfmt
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/backend alembic -c apps/backend/alembic.ini revision --autogenerate
scripts.db:deploy: uv run --project apps/backend alembic -c apps/backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:validate: uv run --project apps/backend alembic -c apps/backend/alembic.ini check
scripts.firmware:build: uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements apps/esp32/requirements.txt platformio run --project-dir apps/esp32
scripts.firmware:upload: uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements apps/esp32/requirements.txt platformio run --project-dir apps/esp32 --target upload
scripts.firmware:monitor: uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements apps/esp32/requirements.txt platformio device monitor --baud 115200
scripts.firmware:test: uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements apps/esp32/requirements.txt platformio test --project-dir apps/esp32 --environment native
